reading.body:
This entry is not a data center. It is a mistagged point for a small web development business that no longer appears to operate.

The name describes web design and development, not server infrastructure. The company's domain is a parked for-sale page, and the stored coordinates resolve to a different current occupant, Hole Hunter Industries, on East Gray Road in Scottsdale. No public evidence connects the address to servers or colocation equipment. The record carries zero megawatts and no published specifications.

For AI infrastructure, the relevant fact is that this row contributes nothing. It adds no capacity, no power draw, and no building. Counting it would inflate a facility tally with a business that never was one. The address also sits several miles from the other eight rows in its batch, so it shares no building with them.

What the data does not tell the reader is how many other entries carry the same defect. One mistagged OpenStreetMap point is a data quality problem, not a trend. The record shows only that this single point was checked, found to be a web development firm, and marked unresolvable.
